dct_description_sm: # Vanuatu Cyclone Judy Cyclone Kevin: Damage Proxy Maps, Mar 2023 The **Earth Observatory of Singapore – Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS)** produced these damage proxy maps for Vanuatu Cyclone Judy Cyclone Kevin (Mar 2023) from synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite images. Each map is a separate ZIP below with its GeoTIFF, a KMZ for Google Earth, the PNG figures and a text file describing how it was made and how to read it. ## Maps in this dataset - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Vanuatu, Cyclone Judy and Cyclone Kevin, 10 Mar 2023, v0.8** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Vanuatu, Cyclone Judy and Cyclone Kevin, 10 Mar 2023, v0.8** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Vanuatu, Cyclone Judy and Cyclone Kevin, 3 Mar 2023, v0.7** - **EOS-RS Damage Proxy Map: Vanuatu, Cyclone Judy and Cyclone Kevin, 3 Mar 2023, v0.7** **More map details and files:** **More map details and files:** **Credits:** Earth Observatory of Singapore - Remote Sensing Lab (EOS-RS), Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2022-2023)
